definitions.explanation: An unfortunate event or accident that causes great damage, suffering, or hardship.

examples.japanese: ⟦{思|おも}わぬ→思う：00492_omou⟧{災難|さいなん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{遭|あ}った→遭う：09500_au⟧。
{災難|さいなん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{忘|わす}れた→忘れる：00474_wasureru⟧⟦{頃|ころ}→頃：03091_koro⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦やってくる→やって来る：17013_yattekuru⟧。
examples.english: Disasters come when you least expect them.

examples.japanese: ⟦それ→それ：00994_sore⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{災難|さいなん}⟦でした→です：09485_desu⟧⟦ね→ね：09474_ne⟧。

notes:
{災難|さいなん} refers to an unfortunate event or misfortune that befalls someone, often suddenly and beyond their control. It can range from minor mishaps to major catastrophes.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {災難|さいなん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{遭|あ}う→遭う：09500_au⟧: to encounter misfortune
- {災難|さいなん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{逃|のが}れる→逃れる：10425_nogareru⟧: to escape disaster
- ⟦{思|おも}わぬ→思う：00492_omou⟧{災難|さいなん}: unexpected misfortune
- {災難|さいなん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{降|ふ}りかかる→降りかかる：28386_furikakaru⟧: misfortune befalls (someone)
- {災難|さいなん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}く→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧: misfortunes continue

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{災害|さいがい}→災害：09636_saigai⟧: disaster (typically natural disasters — earthquakes, typhoons, floods)
- ⟦{不幸|ふこう}→不幸：03595_fukou⟧: misfortune, unhappiness (broader, includes personal hardship)
- ⟦{惨事|さんじ}→惨事：28385_sanji⟧: tragic event, catastrophe (emphasizes horror/severity)
- ⟦{厄災|やくさい}→厄災：24387_yakusai⟧: calamity (more literary/formal)

USAGE:
⟦それ→それ：00994_sore⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{災難|さいなん}⟦でした→です：09485_desu⟧⟦ね→ね：09474_ne⟧ (That was quite a misfortune) is a common sympathetic response when hearing about someone's bad experience. The word often implies that the person is not at fault.
